The ticket is #8841. I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random.

Where it comes from: yesterday at 09:27 in #central-random, Tobias wrote that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on ticket #8841 for support. Pree is in that channel, so she could see this herself. Tobias was answering Hollis's question about "Tobias's dealer account." A January handoff digest says Marrow Fieldworks, a dealer account, changed hands on 5 Jan 2026, so I treated that account as Marrow Fieldworks. Neither message names it outright, so that link is inferred.

In the reply I warned her not to confuse it with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket about Door 6. I also suggested she ask Tobias for the current status, because I couldn't find any ticket files.
